<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#020617; --sky-50:#f0f9ff; --gray-50:#f9fafb; --gray-200:#e5e7eb;
    --accent:#38bdf8; --text:#0f172a; --text-soft:#475569;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{font-family:'Inter',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--text); line-height:1.55; margin:0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; margin:0;}
  .wrap{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:12px; display:block;}
  section{padding:88px 0;}
  .pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; padding:14px 28px; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; text-decoration:none; border:2px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease;}
  .pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .pill-primary{background:var(--accent); color:var(--navy);}
  .pill-outline{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4); color:#fff;}
  .pill-dark{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}

  .site-header{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40; background:rgba(255,255,255,.95); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .site-header .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 24px;}
  .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text); line-height:1.1;}
  .brand .word{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-weight:700; font-size:19px;}
  .brand .word span{color:var(--accent);}
  .brand .tagline{font-size:11px; color:var(--text-soft); font-weight:500;}
  nav{display:flex; gap:28px; align-items:center;}
  nav a{color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:500;}
  nav a:hover{color:var(--accent);}
  .header-cta{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .phone-link{font-weight:600; color:var(--text); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  .nav-toggle{display:none; background:none; border:0; padding:6px; font-size:22px; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text);}
  .header-cta .pill{white-space:nowrap;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    nav{display:none;}
    .nav-toggle{display:inline-flex;}
    .site-header.nav-open nav{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; position:absolute; top:100%; left:0; right:0; background:#fff; border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200); padding:18px 24px;}
  }

  .hero{background:var(--navy); color:#fff; padding:96px 0 72px;}
  .hero .badge{display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); border-radius:999px; padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:48px; color:#fff; max-width:820px;}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero p.lead{max-width:660px; font-size:17px; color:#cbd5e1; margin:22px 0 32px;}
  .hero .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .trust-row{display:flex; gap:32px; flex-wrap:wrap; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); padding-top:26px;}
  .trust-row div{font-size:14px; color:#e2e8f0; font-weight:500;}

  .bg-sky{background:var(--sky-50);}
  .bg-white{background:#fff;}
  .bg-gray{background:var(--gray-50); border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200);}
  .bg-navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .bg-accent{background:var(--accent);}

  .section-head{max-width:680px; margin-bottom:48px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:32px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--text-soft); margin-top:14px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .bg-navy .section-head p{color:#cbd5e1;}

  .grid{display:grid; gap:24px;}
  .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
  .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid-2,.grid-3,.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .feature{padding:4px;}
  .feature .icon{font-size:28px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .feature h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .feature p{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0;}

  .area-chip{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; text-align:center; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;}

  .price-card{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:16px; padding:26px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .price-card.featured{border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent) inset;}
  .price-card .tag{font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); margin-bottom:10px;}
  .price-card h3{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .price-card .price{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-size:22px; font-weight:700; color:var(--navy); margin:8px 0 16px;}
  .price-card .price span{font-size:13px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-soft);}
  .price-card ul{margin:0; padding-left:18px; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--text-soft); flex-grow:1;}
  .price-card ul li{margin-bottom:6px;}

  .stat-strip{display:flex; gap:0; flex-wrap:wrap; text-align:center;}
  .stat-strip div{flex:1; min-width:180px; padding:16px;}
  .stat-strip .num{font-family:'Space Grotesk'; font-size:30px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent);}
  .stat-strip .lbl{font-size:13px; color:#cbd5e1; margin-top:4px;}

  .check-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:grid; gap:14px;}
  .check-list li{display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text-soft);}
  .check-list li b{color:var(--text); font-weight:600;}
  .check-list li::before{content:"✓"; color:var(--accent); font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .bg-navy .check-list li b{color:#fff;}

  details.faq{background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius:12px; padding:18px 22px; margin-bottom:12px;}
  details.faq summary{font-weight:600; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none;}
  details.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
  details.faq summary::after{content:"+"; float:right; font-size:20px; color:var(--accent);}
  details.faq[open] summary::after{content:"-";}
  details.faq p, details.faq ul{color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; margin:14px 0 0;}
  details.faq ul{padding-left:20px;}

  .cta-banner{text-align:center;}
  .cta-banner h2{font-size:32px; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto;}
  .cta-banner p{margin:14px 0 28px; font-size:15.5px;}
  .cta-banner .cta-row{display:flex; gap:16px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}

  footer{padding:48px 0; background:var(--navy); color:#cbd5e1;}
  footer p{color:#94a3b8; font-size:14px; margin:0;}
  .footer-bottom{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); padding-top:20px; margin-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;}
  footer a{color:#cbd5e1; text-decoration:none;}
  .topbar{background:var(--navy);}
  .topbar-inner{max-width:1120px; margin:0 auto; padding:7px 24px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:13px;}
  .open-status{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-weight:600; color:#fff;}
  .os-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#4ade80; flex:none;}
  .open-status.is-open .os-dot{animation:ospulse 1.5s ease-out infinite;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-dot{background:#94a3b8;}
  .os-text{font-weight:700; color:#4ade80;}
  .open-status.is-closed .os-text{color:#cbd5e1;}
  .os-sep{color:#64748b;}
  .os-clock{color:var(--accent); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
  @keyframes ospulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.7);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(74,222,128,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0);}}
</style>
bodyHtml:
🧠 Precision Installs, Not Plug-And-Play · Gold Coast & Surrounds

New Hardware Installs & Upgrades Gold Coast. Done Right, Tested, Benchmarked.

Whether you're an everyday home user, small business owner, creative professional or gamer, Computers Gold Coast provides comprehensive PC hardware installation and upgrade services with major brands like Intel, AMD, ASUS, Gigabyte, Corsair, Samsung and Crucial, either onsite at your home or office, or remotely for diagnostics and optimisation.

Upgrade My PC
✓ BIOS & Compatibility Checks
✓ Thorough Benchmarking
✓ Windows & Mac Hardware
✓ Remote Post-Install Tuning
Full-Service Installs

Full-Service PC Hardware Installation & Upgrades.

Whether you're dealing with sluggish boot times, outdated components, or preparing a custom workstation, we've got you covered.

💾

SSD & HDD Installation

From SATA SSDs to ultra-fast NVMe PCIe Gen4 drives, including data migration and fresh OS installs if required.

🧠

RAM Upgrades

High-frequency DDR4 or DDR5 installs with correct channel configuration and voltage/timing settings in BIOS.

🎮

Graphics Card Upgrades

NVIDIA GeForce and AMD Radeon installs, driver updates, G-SYNC/Freesync configuration and thermal stress testing.

🔌

Power Supply Replacements

Modular or semi-modular PSUs from trusted brands, matched to your system's load with proper cable management.

🧬

CPU & Cooler Installation

Thermal paste application, heatsink/fan mounting and BIOS updates, including AIO coolers and air towers.

🧩

Motherboard Replacements

Case standoff alignment, front-panel headers, memory channel configuration and BIOS flashing for newer CPUs.

Why Choose Computers Gold Coast

Beyond Basic Plug-And-Play Installs.

🧠

Complex Upgrades

BIOS updates, voltage regulation and thermal load balancing for high-performance systems.

🎮

Builds For Gamers & Creatives

Top-tier GPUs, ultra-fast DDR5 RAM and PCIe 4.0/5.0 SSDs for 4K gaming, VR and rendering.

🔍

Thorough Testing & Benchmarks

Cinebench, 3DMark, MemTest86 and CrystalDiskMark to confirm everything runs optimally.

🔗

Remote Post-Install Optimisation

We remotely fine-tune drivers, fan curves and performance profiles after the physical install.

What Our Customers Say

Real Feedback.

"Extremely helpful fixing our computer, especially at short notice. Went out of his way to assist us and I would have no hesitation in recommending his service."

, Greg B., Nerang, QLD

Frequently Asked Questions

Hardware Installation Questions, Answered.

What makes your hardware installation service different from others on the Gold Coast?

We don't just install hardware, we configure and optimise it. We ensure BIOS/UEFI settings are updated, power delivery is sufficient, and the system is fully benchmarked and tested. We also offer ongoing remote support to tweak settings post-installation.

Can you help if I've bought parts online but don't know how to install them?

Absolutely. Many clients purchase components from online retailers but need help putting them together. We can install them, check compatibility, and let you know before you unbox anything if a part isn't right for your build.

Do you work with both Windows and Mac hardware?

Yes, we install SSDs, RAM and logic board components for both Windows PCs and Apple Macs, including MacBooks and iMacs, and handle OS reinstalls and driver setup after hardware installation. See our Apple Mac repairs page for more.

Can you build a gaming PC from scratch if I give you a budget?

Definitely, tell us your budget and preferences (1440p, 4K gaming, streaming, VR), and we'll select compatible, reliable parts, then build, configure and test everything for peak performance. See our custom computer builds service.

Is remote installation or support really possible for hardware?

We can't physically install components remotely, but we can assist post-install: driver updates, firmware flashing, RAID setup, BIOS tuning and thermal monitoring can all be done remotely once the physical parts are in.

Will you help me understand what you're installing and why?

Of course. Part of our value is education, we'll explain why a particular NVMe SSD is better than a standard SATA SSD, or why you might need a higher-wattage PSU for future-proofing.

Related Services

Building From Scratch, Or Just Diagnosing A Fault?

If you're starting completely from scratch, our custom computer build service covers full assembly, not just individual parts. Not sure which component's actually failing? Start with hardware repair & diagnostics. General computer trouble that isn't hardware-related? See computer repairs.

Ready To Upgrade Your System?

Tell us your budget and goals, and we'll handle the rest, installed, configured and benchmarked.
